title: R015 local semantic-neighbourhood map
reconstruction_basis: Published R015 community summaries and community-edge evidence. R014 labels were not used as first-pass classification targets.

nodes.label: sensing / instrumentation
nodes.held_out: P4 omits sensor; literal sensor reappears in 6/6 orders across 21 post-context states; broader family spans all 28

nodes.label: built place / locality
nodes.held_out: P3 omits apartment; literal apartment reappears in 4/6 orders across 12 states; broader family spans 6/6 and all 28

nodes.label: spatial / measurement structure
nodes.held_out: P2 omits line; literal line is weak in summaries but the broader spatial family spans 6/6 and 26 states

nodes.label: organised group / activity
nodes.held_out: P1 omits sessions; literal sessions reappears in 6/6 orders across 18 states; broader family spans all 28

nodes.label: process / comparison / modification
nodes.held_out: No R015 seed names this family; negative manipulation/process/comparison and positive enlargement/transformation/removal recur across all probes

nodes.label: reporting / information
nodes.held_out: No R015 seed names this family; report/output/file/view material recurs across all probes

topology: A positive sensing/instrumentation–built-place/locality cluster persists. Spatial/measurement structure remains the main bridge family but is more negative-dominant than in R014. The negative side contains a spatial–group/activity–process/change chain. Reporting/information remains a secondary positive family. The principal R015 deformation is that the unsupplied process/modification family is strongly represented on the positive side as well as the negative side, producing additional sensing/process and place/process coupling.

P2.literal: 4/6 orders, 2 post-context states in community summaries

caveats: Map nodes and edges are downstream semantic reconstructions, not raw model variables.
Positive and negative sectors remain separately measured; cross-sector family matching does not imply observed cross-sector graph edges.
Network-support values are semantic diagnostics over S06-S27 using representative/extreme community vocabulary and observed community edges.
Literal held-out recovery is weaker for line and apartment than family-level recovery.
R015 was reconstructed before alignment with R014; comparison is recorded separately.
